decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): The Indonesian answer and sense are correct, but the proposed Malaysian learner form is not the standard/common device label supported by Malaysian usage. Malaysian sources use “Mod Kapal Terbang”; “mod penerbangan” is attested mainly as a generic flight-mode term and is less suitable here. The relation remains different-common-word after correction. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
